for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if [ -f /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/logs/k2_l2_calibration.json ]; then
    echo "=== JSON FOUND at attempt $i ==="
    cat /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/logs/k2_l2_calibration.json
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! ps -p 995736 -o pid= > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "=== PROCESS DEAD at attempt $i ==="
    find /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/logs/ -name "*k2*" -o -name "*l2*calib*" 2>/dev/null
    ls -lt /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/logs/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -5
    tail -30 /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/nohup_k2*.out 2>/dev/null
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "attempt $i: still running, sleeping 30s..."
  sleep 30
done
echo "=== TIMEOUT after 20 min ==="

content.text:
JSON 在第 1 次尝试就找到了。结果如下：

## K=2 L2 校准结果

### 实验配置
- Benchmark: object, 5 episodes, seed=42
- 采集步数: 14,512
- ODE steps: 10

### Spearman 相关性

| 指标对 | Spearman ρ | p-value | Go/No-Go |
|--------|-----------|---------|----------|
| K2_L2 vs FMVD | **0.0925** | 6.03e-29 | **No-Go** (ρ < 0.3) |
| K2_L2 vs K10_variance | **0.9979** | 0.0 | **Go** (ρ >> 0.3) |
| K10_variance vs FMVD (baseline) | **0.0825** | 2.33e-23 | **No-Go** (ρ < 0.3) |

### 统计摘要

| 指标 | Mean | Std | P25 | P50 | P75 | P90 |
|------|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| FMVD | 0.0549 | 0.0403 | 0.0277 | 0.0467 | 0.0709 | 0.0938 |
| K10 variance | 0.0049 | 0.0056 | — | — | — | — |
| K2 L2 | 0.0807 | 0.0361 | 0.0550 | 0.0749 | 0.0987 | 0.1265 |

### Go/No-Go 判断

**K2 L2 作为 K10 variance 的廉价替代：Go** — ρ=0.9979，近乎完美相关，K2 L2 可以完美替代 K10 variance 作为不确定性代理。

**K2 L2 作为 FMVD 的预测器：No-Go** — ρ=0.0925，远低于 0.3 阈值。但这与 K10 variance vs FMVD 的 ρ=0.0825 一致，说明问题不在 K2 近似，而在于 ODE variance 类指标本身与 FMVD 的相关性就很弱。
